name: Chunked UV Rasterization with Face ID Storage
definition: Rasterizes a mesh in UV space in memory-friendly chunks, storing the face ID in the alpha channel to enable per-texel face identification and subsequent 3D position interpolation.
summary: Chunked UV Rasterization with Face ID Storage rasterizes 3D meshes in UV space using memory-friendly chunks, storing face IDs in the alpha channel to enable per-texel identification and 3D position interpolation.
